name: io.github.apatureai/bastion
description: In-loop, read-only design review for coding agents: grounded findings, fixes, and recheck before CI.

_meta.ai.apature/status: Installable from npm as `@apatureai/bastion` and launched over stdio (`npx -y @apatureai/bastion`); see the `packages` entry above. No public hosted endpoint is operated, so this listing intentionally declares no `remotes`: an MCP client reading it cannot be pointed at a host that does not answer. To self-host the Streamable HTTP edge instead, run the server yourself (see the README), then add the `remotes` entry described by `ai.apature/self_hosted_remote_template` with your own host.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> or an OAuth-issued access token. Replace <your-mcp-host> with the host you deployed the Streamable HTTP edge on; this template is documentation, not a live endpoint.

_meta.ai.apature/read_only_boundary: Customer-facing: the server judges, explains, and verifies. It never edits code, commits, pushes, or opens pull requests. Submit and recheck create metered jobs; design_review_get and design_review_panel_action are read-only, and a panel apply_fix returns the fix for the caller's coding agent rather than applying it.
